Welcome to Treasure Palms at Inlet Beach! Located less than a mile from one of the most pristine beaches in Florida, our clean, custom home is brimming with amenities that set us apart from your average beach house...making your stay truly exceptional and unforgettable.

🚙Six-seater Golf Cart Included*** (Golf Cart Rates average $100 per night in the area!)
🏖️ Lots of Beach Gear
🚲Five Cruiser Bikes (less than a 1/2 mile to Rosemary)
🏊‍♀️ Community Pool one block away
☕ Stocked Coffee Bar
🌳Large Pirate Ship Treehouse
📷 Two Photo Walls
🏋️‍♀️Peloton Bike and Small Weights
🕹️Two Arcade Units with over 30 games
🛏️Captains Bunk Room
🍗 Outdoor Propane Grill
📚Board Games and Books
💻Comfortable Designated Workspace
📺Smart TVs in every room
👶Baby Gear - High Chair and Pac N Play
👑Two King Bedrooms
🚙 Three car driveway
🪟Two Large Decks
🧴Free starters of Shampoo, Conditioner and Soap

LOCATION! LOCATION! LOCATION! Next to the start of 30A Scenic Highway and the 30Avenue Pavilions, our home is the perfect location to enjoy beach time, shopping, award-winning dining, and lots of outdoor recreation. Rosemary Town Center is a quick bike ride away through a brand-new pedestrian underpass just minutes from our home. Kayak, paddleboard, or walk the nature trails at Camp Helen State Park just a few minutes away. Panama City is 9 miles away where you can reserve a guided dolphin tour, ride the Ferris Wheel at Pier Park, try out an Escape Room, and much more!
- Less than 2 miles to the grocery store
- Walk, Bike, or Golf Cart to 30 Avenue Restaurants and Shops
- Close to the towns of Rosemary Beach, Alyce Beach, Seaside, Grayton Beach, Seagrove and more!
- 20 minutes to Panama City Beach Pier Park, snorkel and dolphin tours, cruises to Shell Island, fishing expeditions and much more.

LET US HELP YOU PLAN THE PERFECT FAMILY VACATION!
We will send you a list of our area recommendations after booking to help with your vacation planning. We are also happy to answer any questions you may have about our home or the area!

ITEMS OF NOTE:
***Waiver and $30 separate administration fee will be requested from guest, payable to 30A Gulf Carts (our golf cart leasing company) a few days before your arrival
- No parties allowed at this property. Vacation homes in the area may lose their rental license if parties occur.
- Rental agreement and security deposit between the guest and owner of the property will be required. Per our rental insurance, the person who signs our rental agreement must be 25 years or older and stay at the property.
- Walton County Short Term Rental License Number STR23-00828
- Owner/manager may request drivers license off AirBnb platform for liability purposes.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

gallery.name: A guest favorite is our Photo Hallway, a space for capturing memories. We want you to have the best vacation! After booking, we provide you with our recommendations for restaurants and activities. Feel free to reach out to us also! We are here to help!

When you enter our home you will be welcomed with light and cozy beach decor. Many of our guests tell us Treasure Palms "feels like home". The front of our home has two large porches with seating for enjoying your morning coffee.
Our home has a spacious living room equipped with a Smart TV. Enjoy your work/life balance with a lovely desk area. 500 mbps Internet throughout our home.
Relax in the cozy Master King Retreat with ensuite bathroom, Peloton Bike, Smart TV, Large Private Deck, and huge walk-in closet. We provide USB charging ports on nightstands.
So many ways to explore! Our home comes equipped with a six-person golf cart and 5 cruiser bikes for our guests to enjoy!
Another new amenity for 2025! We have two arcade game consoles each with 14 classic games including Galaga, Pac Man, Street Fighter, Pac Man, Super Pac Man and much more!

Imaginations will run wild in our nautical themed bunkroom two twins and one full. Our ships' cabin bunks come complete with portholes and ship reading lights. A treasure map wall adds adventure and fun to the room, perfect for young (and old) explorers!
Kids (and adults) can explore the "seas" and hunt for treasure on our Pirate Ship Treehouse!
Known for its blue clear waters and pristine white sand, Inlet Beach was named a "beach that looks like the Caribbean" by Southern Living...and it's just .7 miles from our home!
Interior
Gather in the spacious dining room area to prepare meals, dine, and play games.
Enjoy our second bedroom that also has a King Bed and Smart tV! Perfect for vacationing with teenagers or another family. USB charging ports on nightstands.

We provide a selection of coffee and teas, so you can enjoy a perfect cup of coffee or tea every morning. Our coffee bar is also equipped with syrup, creamers, and sweeteners, so you can personalize your drink to your liking.
Take a break from the beach at our Community Pool a block from our house. Perfect if you are looking for a relaxing day on the water minus the sand clean up!
Our beach essentials closet is stocked with everything you will need for the perfect day near the water. We provide chairs, sand toys, boogie boards, beach bag and a travel cooler and more!
Kick back after a day of fun on our backyard porch.
Take in the view from 2 large front decks. Grab your morning coffee or tea from our coffee bar and start your day off right!

Our kitchen is equipped with all the essential appliances, including a refrigerator, stove, oven, microwave, and dishwasher. We also provide all the necessary cookware, utensils, and dishes, so you can prepare meals with ease during your vacation.
Whether you're up for a family game night or an afternoon with a good book, you'll find everything you need to relax and have fun together.

Our master bathroom is located just steps away from the master bedroom, ensuring that you have easy access to your private retreat whenever you need it. We provide small bottles of shampoo, conditioner and shower gel, as well as makeup washcloths.
Our home is packed with amenities and special touches! From games to bikes, beach gear, and more, we’ve thought of everything to make your stay comfortable, fun, and memorable for all ages.

Sunset at Inlet Beach
Three Inlet Beach Public Access Points are less than a mile away. Inlet Beach is a paradise with crystal clear waters and white sand beaches.
The 30A Gulf waters are a stunning shade of clear emerald blue green, thanks to microscopic plankton. The color and clearness of the water make the entire area a snorkeling and swimming paradise!
Treasure Palms directly behind 30Avenue Shops and Restaurant Pavillion. A 5-minute walk.
